scenicChapters.title: Armenia Selim Pass and Lake Sevan Route
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 6.5%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Armenia Selim Pass and Lake Sevan Route
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2410 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

armenia-selim-pass-and-lake-sevan-route.story: Out of Yerevan, one way: 261 km, roughly 4 h 18 in the saddle. It goes by way of Noravank, Selim Pass and Orbelian Caravanserai. The highest point is about 2,400 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
